issues: The README Requirements list 'One or more high-end NVIDIA GPUs, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA 10.0 toolkit and cuDNN 7.5' and say the custom ops are 'compiled on the fly using NVCC'. The examiner's reason itself says it is only 'feasible on CPU if the CUDA custom ops fall back to the reference implementation'.

Goal leaks the fix: 'its custom CUDA ops (fused_bias_act, upfirdn_2d) default to impl='cuda', so a CPU-compatible path must be arranged'. The probe patched 5 files and added an NCHW->NHWC conv shim to pass.

previous.goal: Make `python run_generator.py generate-images --network=gdrive:networks/stylegan2-ffhq-config-f.pkl --seeds=66,230 --truncation-psi=1.0 --result-dir=<dir>` run on a CPU-only machine (no GPU, no nvcc), producing seed0066.png and seed0230.png in a run subdirectory of <dir>. The repo needs TensorFlow 1.x and its custom CUDA ops (fused_bias_act, upfirdn_2d) default to impl='cuda', so a CPU-compatible path must be arranged. The network pickle is downloaded from nvlabs-fi-cdn.nvidia.com.
